FLAGSHIP ARCHITECTURAL DOSSIER

Vel Ra Perfumes Concept Interior

A bespoke spatial sensory boutique interior combining book-matched Italian Calacatta Gold marble, Titanium Gold PVD micro-detailing, traditional Islamic architectural mashrabiya geometry, and continuous 3000K dotless perimeter halo illumination.

Materials Palette 3D Interactive Twin CAD Blueprints & Dimensions
CURATED PALETTE & SPECIFICATIONS

Master Materials & Finishes Board

Authentic architectural specification of luxury materials, bespoke metal treatments, stone selections, and precision glass assemblies.

M-01 STONE

Calacatta Gold Italian Marble

High-grade natural dolomite marble characterized by a pure crystalline white ground with dramatic warm golden ochre, caramel, and honey-toned veining rivers. Honed and sealed with an anti-staining oleophobic finish for all primary customer consultation surfaces.

HONED & POLISHED BOOK-MATCHED SLABS ANTI-STAIN COATING
M-02 METALWORK

Brushed Titanium Gold PVD

Grade 304 architectural stainless steel finished with Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Titanium Gold. Delivers extreme surface hardness, scratch resistance, and an anti-fingerprint passivated satin sheen across all perimeter trims, plinths, and signage framing.

PVD TITANIUM COATING SATIN BRUSHED ANTI-FINGERPRINT
M-03 FEATURE RELIEF

Geometric Gold Mashrabiya Lattice

Laser-cut precision architectural mashrabiya panels featuring traditional geometric lattice patterns. Positioned over warm diffused acrylic lightboxes to create dynamic backlit depth behind perfume display shelves and the cashier feature wall.

CNC LASER-CUT BACKLIT DIFFUSION ISLAMIC GEOMETRY
M-04 JOINERY & WOOD

Warm Ivory Fluted Millwork

Precision-milled vertical ribbed fluted panels with high-pressure polyurethane satin enamel in bespoke warm ivory (RAL 9001). Applied seamlessly around the curved consultation island pedestal base and cashier cabinetry.

CNC VERTICAL FLUTING POLYURETHANE SATIN WARM IVORY RAL 9001
M-05 GLAZING

Ultra-Clear Low-Iron Tempered Glass

Optiwhite extra-clear float glass with minimal iron oxide content to eliminate the typical greenish tint. Tempered and CNC edge-arrised with flat pencil polish for all cantilevered floating fragrance display shelves and storefront vitrines.

OPTIWHITE LOW-IRON TEMPERED SAFETY FLAT PENCIL POLISH
M-06 FLOORING

Calacatta Gold Polished Floor Tiles

Large-format porcelain slabs replicating authentic Calacatta Gold veining with high specular reflectivity. Installed with rectified micro-joints and matching gold epoxy grout to create a continuous liquid-stone floor plane.

LARGE FORMAT RECTIFIED JOINTS HIGH SPECULAR GLOSS

Architectural Joinery Features & Photographic Details

Direct photographic crops highlighting exact materials, joinery details, and illumination profiles.

ZONE 01 • EXTERIOR & ENTRY

Shopfront & Glazed Entrance Portal

SPAN: 590 CM CLEAR DOOR: 90 × 210 CM

Classic European storefront proportion with stone pilaster fluting, triangular pediment entrance door frame, and full-height tempered display glazing.

ZONE 02 • PERIMETER RETAIL WALL

Illuminated Perimeter Perfume Shelves

DEPTH: 35 CM SHELF TIERS: 40 CM EQ

Continuous arched niche shelving with integrated dotless COB LED halos, backlit Islamic geometric lattice panels, and 10mm tempered Optiwhite cantilever glass shelves.

ZONE 03 • CENTRAL HIGHLIGHT

Central Consultation Island Counter

230 L × 90 W × 95 H CM CLEARANCE: ≥ 120 CM

Organic curved island counter featuring a monolithic honed Italian Calacatta Gold marble slab top, gold nosing rim, and vertical fluted pedestal base.

ZONE 04 • TRANSACTION & PACKAGING

POS Cashier & Wrap Desk

220 L × 80 W × 105 H CM DESK HEIGHT: 85 CM

Ergonomic point-of-sale desk with sunken cable chases, packaging drawer bank, and full-height backlit 3D gold brand logo feature wall.

ZONE 05 • VIP DISPLAY

Right Perimeter Symmetrical Showcases

DEPTH: 40 CM WIDTH: 90 CM BAYS

High-value fragrance vitrines with lockable low-iron safety glass fronts, Titanium Gold arch surrounds, and focused anti-glare micro-spots.

ZONE 06 • SPATIAL ENVELOPE

Ceiling Coffer & Calacatta Gold Flooring

CEILING SLAB: 340 CM TILES: 120 × 60 CM

25cm recessed perimeter ceiling coffer pelmet casting indirect warm illumination over 120×60cm rectified Calacatta Gold porcelain floor slabs.

ZONE 07 • BACK-OF-HOUSE ACCESS

Service & Restroom Flush Pivot Door

DOOR D: 80 × 210 CM WC OFFSET: 67 CM

Concealed flush pivot door seamlessly integrated into wall paneling with illuminated geometric mashrabiya signage plate above.

IRISH RETAIL COMPLIANCE • BS EN 12464-1

Bespoke Architectural Lighting System

Engineered lighting design delivering 98+ CRI color accuracy, dotless COB shelf illumination, and glare-controlled architectural accents.

LIGHT TYPE L-01

Perimeter Shelf COB LED Halo

High-density 480 LED/m continuous COB ribbon embedded inside a 10×8mm micro-extrusion with frosted opal diffuser.

CRI 98 (R9 > 90) 3000K WARM WHITE 12W / METER
LIGHT TYPE L-02

Ceiling Cove Indirect Lighting

Indirect high-lumen linear wash hidden within 25cm drop coffer pelmet. Casts gentle 350-lux ambient glow across the store.

3000K WARM GLOW 16W / METER DALI-2 DIMMABLE
LIGHT TYPE L-03

Architectural Gimbal Downlight

Recessed ceiling downlight with deep black baffle reflector ensuring UGR < 13 glare-free customer comfort.

UGR < 13 GLARE-FREE 24° ACCENT BEAM 15W CITIZEN COB
LIGHT TYPE L-04

3D Backlit Signage Halo

Reverse-mounted IP65 LED modules behind 3D Titanium Gold brand lettering casting a floating warm halo onto the mashrabiya wall.

3000K HALO WASH 12V CONSTANT VOLTAGE IP65 RATED
